name: Natural Text to Speech
author: Reinvent WP

sections.description:
Read aloud your post with natural best human like voices with highlight sentence and the words that are being spoken, Available free and pro version!

This is lightweight and easy-to-use WordPress plugin that converts your post or page content into natural-sounding audio.

Subscribe the PRO version here so the voice source is using human like sound.

Because in PRO version you can integrating this plugin with audio file producer (TTS API) like OpenAI TTS, ElevenLabs, Google Cloud TTS

Features:
– Text to speech with highlight the sentence and word that are being spoken by audio file
* Can be integrated with good audio file producer (TTS API) like OpenAI TTS, ElevenLabs, Google Cloud TTS
* Easily integrated using a simple shortcode.

Support

For support, please visit our support page at https://reinventwp.vercel.app
or contact us at reinventwp@gmail.com

External services

This plugin connects to our API services “https://reinventwp-services.vercel.app” to process subscription authentication, store your Text To Speech API secret-key,
As a proxy for the secretkey to making the audio file and do caching strategy.

It receive:
– Your details like who you are (freemius user information, email, your website url)
– TTS API secret key

It sends:
– JWT token for authentication
– Audio file

This External API is provided by our own service “ReinventWP”: terms of conditions, privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install via the WordPress Plugin Installer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Create a new post or page and insert the shortcode [natural_tts]
  4. The plugin will automatically insert a “Listen” button above the post content that, when clicked, reads the text aloud.
sections.faq:
Is it free? I choose free plan, can i just install?

Its free to install, But the free plan audio source is only with browser web speech synthesis, which the voice is robotic.

not as good as using audio file that generated from TTS API like ElevenLabs

you must choose PRO plan to integrating this plugin with TTS API.

How i use PRO plan?

  1. Goto https://reinventwp.vercel.app/ -> choose your plan -> pay
  2. Then automatically you got email from freemius to login into your dashboard and got plugin license key.
  3. You can download the plugin.zip then goto your WP admin page Plugins then upload the zip.
  4. Enter the license key
  5. Enjoy

Can I customize voice, color, etc?

Yes, ofcourse! We commit to our user to provide the best text to speech solution for WordPress!
